title: Smart Email Auto-Reply System
description:
Small businesses and freelancers answer the same questions by email every day: prices, availability, order status, opening hours. An email assistant should sort incoming mail into categories and prepare a reply for business inquiries, using only facts the business has provided.

Constraints

  • Works with an existing mailbox (for example Gmail) without moving to a new tool.
  • Replies are drafts that a person reviews and sends; nothing is sent automatically.
  • Newsletters, spam, automated notifications and personal mail get no reply.
  • Prices, dates and stock levels must never be invented.
goals:
• Every unread business inquiry has a categorized reply draft in its thread within 15 minutes.
  • Drafts need no factual corrections in at least 9 out of 10 cases during a two-week review.
  • No replies are drafted for newsletters, spam or automated mail in the review sample.
  • Time spent on routine replies drops by half, measured over a typical week.
